A Raid and Po Town (Japanese: 突入！！ポータウン！ Charge!! Po Town!) is the 17th chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
 
==Major events==
Hau asks if he can join Ilima and the other Trial Captains to meet with Team Skull at Po Town.
realizes that is angry that he insulted his appearance earlier and apologizes.
Mimikyu joins Sun's team and is nicknamed Penny.
takes a photo of Sun and Penny, successfully completing the trial.
Realizing the Mirage Berry for was left behind on Professor Kukui's yacht, Sun uses Search to look for another one.
Sina and Dexio spot Sun and decide to have him assist in finding the .
After discovering that Nebby knows about the guardian deities and Rotom can translate it, Sun decides to ask Nebby directly how to calm the deities down without the need for Mirage Berries.
Nebby is revealed to have evolved into a , which is completely unresponsive.
The Trial Captains and Hau arrive at Po Town, but are accosted by several s.
Guzma appears and, after hearing they only want to talk, agrees to the Captains' demands, but only if they're able to make it to him first.
A , , and appear to surround the Captains and Hau.
At the Aether House, Sun counts his money and discovers he only needs ten million yen more to complete his goal.
